scan_strategy.wave0_strategy: Python binding does not expose ScanStrategy. Wave 0 uses process_pdf() default detection path for full detect+extract+markdown, plus extract_pages_markdown() for per-page Markdown/OCR flags. Full strategy is documented for Rust process_pdf_with_options only.
